summary: Full-stack testing of KP Studio trainer portal. Backend: 23/23 pytest tests passed (auth, clients CRUD, contracts + PDF download + signed upload/retrieve, payments, public leads, dashboard stats, auth protection). Frontend: end-to-end Playwright flow passed - homepage renders, public lead form submits, /admin redirects unauthenticated users to /admin/login, wrong password shows error, correct login lands on dashboard with all stat cards (Active clients / Revenue / Pending contracts / New leads) + Revenue trend chart, Clients page allows add client with modal + search filter, client row navigates to detail page, Contracts & Waivers tab generates contract with a working PDF download button rendered, Payments tab logs payment and it displays, Leads page shows the previously-submitted public lead with Add-as-client and delete controls.

issues: /api/auth/me returns 401 on public pages (expected, session probe) — surfaces as red console error; consider silencing or short-circuiting when no cookie is present to keep console clean

critical_code_review_comments: Cookies are set with Secure=True + SameSite=None — correct for https preview but will break local http dev; consider env-driven flag.
validate_request_token only decodes JWT — does not confirm user still exists (get_current_user does). Minor: acceptable since download endpoints are non-destructive.

seed_admin updates password when env password changes but does not lock brute-force; no rate-limit / lockout implemented (playbook mentions 5-fail lockout — not present). Not in scope per problem statement but noted.
server.py is ~586 lines and includes PDF builder inline; consider splitting build_contract_pdf and routers into modules if it grows.
clients endpoint returns raw docs excluding _id via projection — good. create_client uses clean() which mutates the inserted dict after insert; ok because insert_one uses dict(doc) copy.
seed_data_creation: Tests create TEST_-prefixed clients/leads/contracts/payments and clean them up in the same run. UI test left one TEST_UIClient_* + contract + payment and TEST_UILead_* + one earlier 'Test Lead' visible on the admin. Safe to leave or purge.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend pytest suite at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py covers full CRUD + PDF + signed upload/retrieve + dashboard + auth protection. PDF content stream is compressed by ReportLab, so text-search assertions inside PDF bytes will fail — verify structure (%PDF- header, %%EOF trailer, size > 3KB) instead. httpOnly cookies require session-based requests.Session() (which the fixture uses). Public /api/leads works without auth.
